mainHall.alt: The main hall just before the first talk: a lit stage with a blank screen, rows of people seated, the river and a suspension bridge through tall windows.

congressCentre.alt: A long limestone congress building with a deep entrance canopy, a sunny plaza with palm trees and a yellow tram in front.

riversideHotel.alt: A white hotel front with blue-and-white tiles and iron balconies, café tables outside and the river and bridge beyond.

alfamaRooms.alt: A narrow terracotta guesthouse on a steep cobbled lane, geraniums on its balconies and washing on a line.

hostelBelem.alt: A whitewashed hostel courtyard with a lemon tree, its blue door open onto a room of wooden bunk beds.
